### 🔵 Needs a closer look Reported full-suite failures and incomplete current-head compatibility, lint/schema, and docs-site validation require human confirmation before approval. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Fixes #892 by publishing configured reports after completed grading failures, so Waza can produce JUnit XML while retaining a nonzero exit status. **Changes:** - Write reports before returning the grading error, preserving last-model selection and joining any reporter write error. - Add regression coverage for failed grading with successful and failed JUnit writes. - Document failed-evaluation reporting behavior and add a changelog entry. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `site/​src/​content/​docs/​reference/​cli.mdx` | Adds a comment explaining JUnit output after grading failures. | | `README.md` | Adds the same clarification to the reporting example. | | `docs/​GUIDE.md` | Documents report publication and combined error behavior. | | `cmd/​waza/​cmd_run.go` | Publishes reports before returning grading errors. | | `cmd/​waza/​cmd_run_test.go` | Tests report output and preservation of both error causes. | | `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the reporting fix for #892. |
Review effort: Balanced
